categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor packaging and testing services, accounting for 99% of revenue, with additional activities in electronic materials wholesale, component manufacturing, and investment. It focuses on IC packaging and testing, including MEMS sensor packaging and automotive and medical electronics packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as stacking, multi-chip modules, system-in-package, and MEMS packaging. It utilizes precise manufacturing processes including wire bonding, clip bonding, molding, plating, and testing, with ongoing development in high-performance, miniaturized, and multi-functional sensor packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major IC design companies in Taiwan and international clients in sectors such as mobile devices, automotive electronics, memory, power management, and communication components. The company serves end markets including smartphones, PCs, automotive, IoT devices, and wearable electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are predominantly in Asia (86%), with additional markets in Europe (9%) and the Americas (5%). It operates subsidiaries and sales agents in Taiwan and the United States, supporting global customer bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC packaging and testing services that follow wafer fabrication and precede distribution to end customers or system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing customer service, improving existing processes, developing new packaging materials and processes, and innovating multi-functional MEMS and sensor packaging. The company invests in green manufacturing, automation, and expanding automotive and medical electronics packaging capabilities, aligning with 5G and AI-driven market trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor packaging and testing services. The company also derives income from electronic materials sales and investment activities, with a focus on volume-based sales of packaged and tested semiconductor components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Huatai, Nanmao, Chaofeng, Siliconware Precision, Dianfan, Fumao, and Huadong. The company positions itself as a competitive supplier with strong technical capabilities, quality certifications (IATF16949, ISO14001), and a focus on niche, high-growth products like MEMS packaging.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.37 billion in 2024, a 3% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to the parent company of NT$168 million. It maintains a stable asset base of about NT$7.5 billion and equity of NT$5.48 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity and technology despite recent economic challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precise semiconductor packaging and testing services with diversified product offerings including advanced MEMS and sensor modules. It differentiates through strong customer relationships, flexible capacity management, continuous innovation, environmental sustainability, and compliance with international quality and environmental standards.
